item.title: 0.6.3-beta.1
item.description:
# Agent HUD 0.6.3-beta.1
## Compatibility
**Requires Agent HUD for iPhone 1.7.2 or later** for iPhone and Apple Watch sync. Update the iPhone app before updating the Mac. Older iPhone versions cannot read this release's data.
[Get the iPhone app](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6812113619).
If the required iPhone version is not yet on the App Store, cross-device features require the corresponding TestFlight version.
Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later.
## Changes
### New
- Speaks nine languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese. Pick one in Settings → General → Language, or let it follow the system. - Adds "Take me around" to the card that tells what an update adds. It starts the getting-started tour beside the HUD, and the card counts as read. - Reads Qoder, QoderWork, TRAE, WorkBuddy, CodeBuddy, ZCode and MiniMax Code accounts from each app's own sign-in. Each region is its own account: Qoder CN, TRAE CN and CodeBuddy CN show apart from the international ones. - Lets agents start DeepSeek Harness sessions, through Agent HUD's plugin in a running Harness. With none running, the Harness desktop app opens. - Lets an agent that reads the answer itself leave out the reply line (#75). With `reply_hint: false` on `send_message` or `start_session`, the message ends by asking the recipient to answer in its turn, instead of sending a message back. - Opens the windows a sign-in page asks for beside the sign-in window, and presents the system's own browser to the site, so sign-ins that open a second window or check the browser go through.
### Fixes
- Delivers agent messages to Antigravity on Windows (#77). Finding Antigravity's server took over 6 seconds on some computers, longer than a message may wait, so every message was refused. It now takes milliseconds. - Stops marking CodeBuddy, Qoder CN and QoderWork as "Requests only" on the Remote page; their conversations sync to the phone too.

# Agent HUD 0.7.0
## Compatibility
**Requires Agent HUD for iPhone 1.7.2 or later** for iPhone and Apple Watch sync. Update the iPhone app before updating the Mac. Older iPhone versions cannot read this release's data.
[Get the iPhone app](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6812113619).
Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later.
## Changes
### New
- Web Remote (experimental): follow your sessions and answer them from a browser on any device. Pair a browser by scanning a QR code or opening a link, then allow it on the computer once it shows the same code. Off the home network, the page talks to this computer through Agent HUD's relay, end-to-end encrypted. On the home network, this computer can serve the page itself, for its own browser and for other devices on the network (also at its Tailscale address). The page shows sessions, conversations with the pictures and videos an agent hands over, requests to answer, each session's task list and changed files, and the project's files, in nine languages. Turn it on in Settings → Experimental → Web Remote, with Agent HUD Remote on. - iPhone away from home: an iPhone paired over the local network reaches this computer through the same relay when it is out, instead of only through iCloud. This needs Agent HUD for iPhone 1.7.15, coming to the App Store shortly. - Messages that ask for a reply are followed up when none comes. If the recipient's turn ends without answering, Agent HUD asks it once more for the reply, at most twice per message, so the sender no longer waits without end. - Under "Let agents message each other" in Settings, "Ask for replies" now has three choices: don't ask, only when needed (the default), always ask. - An agent's own Live status, Answer in the HUD and Approve automatically switches now win over the switch for every agent, so one agent can approve automatically while the rest don't. - MCP: `list_models` lists the reasoning efforts Codex and DeepSeek Harness offer, and `start_session` takes one (#175, thanks @walker95478). - A turn that failed, hit a limit or lost its session shows a warning sign on its card instead of a reply bubble.
### Fixes
- ZCode 4.0: the quota reads again instead of "Not signed in"; Agent HUD unseals the new credential format with ZCode's key from the system credential store (#190, thanks @tianhuanyun). - MiniMax Code: the current `auth.json` format is read (#193, #196, thanks @ThierryKou). - Antigravity: one row order and one set of hidden rows for every Google account (#113, #182, thanks @zqy5618). On macOS, the `agy` inside Antigravity 2.0 Desktop (Gemini.app) is found for messages (#98, thanks @23moriarty-cyber). - Messaging: a slow delivery no longer holds up every other session. A message to Codex on Windows, which starts a Codex of its own and could take a minute, made `list_sessions`, `send_message` and `call_result` from all sessions wait and fail with "Application data is busy". Now only a second message into the same session waits for it; a call that comes again still sends once. That short-lived Codex also starts without the MCP servers in its config, which made it slower (#192, thanks @zqy5618). - Messaging: each MCP entry names its client, so an app started from a Claude Code session (such as DeepSeek Harness) is no longer taken for that session. Existing entries are updated at launch; Codex's entry is edited in place, keeping its other settings. - Codex sessions that were open while Agent HUD updated or restarted keep Agent HUD's messaging tools instead of needing Codex to restart. - Qoder: an organization's credit usage is computed from its counts, so a small share no longer rounds to zero (#179, thanks @mrdrivingduck). - GitHub Copilot: turning on quota reading first says which GitHub sign-ins it reads, and asks (#195, thanks @Chain813). - Windows: Agent HUD now keeps its data in `%USERPROFILE%\.agenthud` instead of AppData, moved there automatically on first launch, so the Claude desktop app installed from claude.ai (MSIX) receives Agent HUD's messages. - Windows: Codex Desktop sessions started in a project folder join that project (#181), and Antigravity session starts use one Desktop endpoint from start to first message (#183), thanks @walker95478. - Windows: when the app can't write its data because it was started from a folder marked Low integrity, the message says so and how to fix it. - macOS: agent marks are scaled with high-quality smoothing, so their edges stay smooth on a 1x screen (#198, thanks @kiiiiiritoooo). - WorkBuddy and other grouped clients offer the quota sign-in on their own page. - Chinese: Allow reads 允许, as the other approval buttons do.
